questions.title: Highest Residential Electricity Price
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the highest average residential electricity price.
questions.disclaimer: Average residential retail price of electricity in cents per kilowatt-hour, all sectors annualized. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Energy Information Administration — Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.A

questions.title: Most ZIP Codes
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most ZIP codes assigned by the US Postal Service.
questions.disclaimer: Total count includes standard, PO Box, unique (single-recipient) and military ZIP codes. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: USPS ZIP Code Directory (aggregated by UnitedStatesZipCodes.org)

questions.title: Most Licensed Drivers
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most licensed drivers.
questions.disclaimer: Count of active licensed drivers (all classes) by state of residence, in millions. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Federal Highway Administration — Highway Statistics Series Table DL-1C

questions.title: Highest Firearm Death Rate
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the highest age-adjusted firearm death rate.
questions.disclaimer: Deaths from all firearm-related injuries (suicide, homicide, accidental) per 100,000 residents, age-adjusted. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: CDC WONDER — Firearm Mortality by State

questions.title: Most Bird Species Observed
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most bird species ever observed and accepted by state records committees.
questions.disclaimer: Cumulative all-time count of species accepted on official state checklists. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: American Birding Association / eBird State Totals

questions.title: Most Native American Reservation Land Area
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most Native American reservation and trust land area.
questions.disclaimer: Total federal trust and reservation acreage held for tribes and individuals; excludes Alaska Native Corporation lands (ANCSA) which have a different legal status. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Bureau of Indian Affairs — Land Area Representation Data

questions.title: Most H-1B Approvals
questions.prompt: Name the US states where the most H-1B specialty-occupation petitions are approved.
questions.disclaimer: Number of initial + continuing H-1B approvals for beneficiaries whose worksite is located in each state. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Most Pickleball Courts
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most known pickleball courts (dedicated + shared-use lined).
questions.disclaimer: Total known playable courts including dedicated pickleball courts and tennis/multi-use courts lined for pickleball. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Highest DUI Arrest Rate
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the highest rate of DUI arrests per 100,000 residents.
questions.disclaimer: Driving-under-the-influence arrests per 100,000 residents. Rates reflect enforcement intensity and legal thresholds as much as underlying impaired-driving prevalence. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: FBI Uniform Crime Reporting — Crime in the US, Arrests by State

questions.title: Most Operating Nuclear Reactors
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most commercial nuclear power reactors currently in operation, from most to fewest.
questions.disclaimer: Counts operating commercial reactors licensed by the NRC; excludes research reactors and units in decommissioning. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: US Nuclear Regulatory Commission — Operating Reactors

questions.title: Highest Coal Share of Electricity Generation
questions.prompt: Name the US states where coal makes up the largest share of in-state electricity generation.
questions.disclaimer: Share of total electricity generated within the state that comes from coal-fired power plants; excludes imported power. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Energy Information Administration — State Electricity Profiles

questions.title: Highest Natural Gas Share of Electricity
questions.prompt: Name the US states where natural gas makes up the largest share of in-state electricity generation.
questions.disclaimer: Share of in-state electricity generation from natural gas; excludes imports and behind-the-meter generation. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Energy Information Administration — State Electricity Profiles

questions.title: Highest Hydropower Share of Electricity
questions.prompt: Name the US states where conventional hydroelectric power supplies the largest share of in-state electricity generation.
questions.disclaimer: Conventional hydroelectric only; excludes pumped-storage hydro (which is net-consumer of electricity). DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: US Energy Information Administration — State Electricity Profiles

questions.title: Highest Nuclear Share of Electricity
questions.prompt: Name the US states where nuclear power supplies the largest share of in-state electricity generation.
questions.disclaimer: Share of net in-state generation from nuclear power reactors. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: US Energy Information Administration — State Electricity Profiles

questions.title: Most Total Electricity Generated
questions.prompt: Name the US states that generate the most total electricity annually across all sources.
questions.disclaimer: Total net electricity generation from all fuels (utility-scale + small-scale) measured in terawatt-hours (TWh). Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Energy Information Administration — State Electricity Profiles

questions.title: Most Superfund NPL Sites
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most Superfund sites listed on the EPA National Priorities List, from most to fewest.
questions.disclaimer: Counts current and proposed final NPL sites; excludes deleted sites and federal facilities may be listed separately by some tallies. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US EPA — Superfund National Priorities List
